numerical_claims.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026 section states: 'By the end of 2026, Impero expects Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to reach between DKK 53M and 57M, corresponding to an ARR growth rate of approx. 15% to 23%. For 2026, EBITDA is expected to be in the range of DKK –2M to DKK 1M.'

candidate_sentences.text: For the full year 2026, Impero expects ARR to reach between DKK 53M and 57M, reflecting a growth rate of approximately 15% to 23%, and anticipates EBITDA to be in the range of negative DKK 2M to positive DKK 1M.

numerical_claims.claim: ARR growth rate was in the upper end of the revised guidance range of 11% to 19%
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Financial highlights for 2025: 'ARR growth rate of 19% YoY was in the upper end of the revised ARR growth range of 11%–19%, in line with Company Announcement 19–2025.'

candidate_sentences.text: This ARR growth rate was in the upper end of the revised guidance range of 11% to 19%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero achieved 19% year-on-year growth in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) to DKK 46.2M at end-2025, with EBITDA improving to DKK -3.1M (better end of revised guidance range).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial highlights: 'ARR amounted to DKK 46.2M, corresponding to a 19% year-on-year growth rate... EBITDA ended at DKK -3.1M which is in the better end of the revised EBITDA guidance range of DKK -5M to -3M (Company Announcement No. 19-2025)'. Management commentary confirms ARR growth and EBITDA improvement.

candidate_sentences.text: Annual Recurring Revenue reached DKK 46.2M at the end of 2025, corresponding to a 19% year-on-year growth rate from DKK 38.7M on 31 December 2024.
This ARR growth rate was in the upper end of the revised guidance range of 11% to 19%.
EBITDA also improved significantly, ending at negative DKK 3,113 thousand compared to negative DKK 8,714 thousand in 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: The company maintained exceptionally low churn of 1% in 2025 and achieved a Net Revenue Retention Rate (NRR) of 106%, with Average ARR per Account (ARPA) reaching a record DKK 228T.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Financial highlights: 'Impero's ARR growth rate of 19% YoY was in the upper end... exceptionally low churn rate of 1% in 2025... NRR ended at 106% in 2025'. ARR development and SaaS metrics table confirms NRR, churn, and ARPA figures.

candidate_sentences.text: SaaS metrics remained solid, highlighted by an exceptionally low churn rate of 1% and a Net Revenue Retention rate of 106%, compared to 108% in 2024.
Average ARR per account rose to a record high of DKK 228 thousand, up 8% from the previous year, supported by a land-and-expand strategy and a gross uplift of 12%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero surpassed 200 customers by end-2025, with customer base diversification (40% of Danish C25 index and 22.5% of German DAX index) and reduced top-10 customer concentration to 20% of ARR.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'By the end of 2025, we reached a significant milestone as our customer base surpassed 200 customers... total customer coverage is 40% of the C25 index and 22.5% of the DAX index... top 10 customer concentration measured on ARR has decreased from 37% to 20% as of year-end 2025'.

verified_key_information_units.information: Growth was driven primarily by Denmark (22% YoY net new ARR growth) and DACH region (26% YoY growth, 44% of total ARR), with strategic expansion planned for UK, Nordics, and Benelux markets.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: ARR development and SaaS metrics: 'In Denmark... 22% YoY... DACH region... 26% growth YoY... ARR from other markets declined to DKK 5.5M... strategic focus to expand... UK as well as Benelux'. Management commentary details regional performance and expansion plans.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key product milestones included launch of Control Testing module, AI-augmented engineering adoption, and initiation of Entity Management development planned for 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'True to previous commitments, we have delivered on launching the Control Testing module in July 2025... advancing our AI agenda... Entity Management – supporting segmentation across global enterprises... delivery planned for 2026'. Product milestones section details features and AI integration.

verified_key_information_units.information: Impero raised DKK 15M via directed issue in December 2025, ending 2025 with DKK 18.9M cash; the Board deferred the ambition for recurring cash flow positivity before end-2026 to fund growth investments.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Equity and capital: 'raised DKK 15M in a private placement in December 2025... equity stood at DKK 15.4M... cash position of DKK 18.9M'. Strategy update: 'Board of Directors believes that growth investments will create more long-term value than pursuing cash flow positivity before end of 2026... deferred its ambition... as announced in Company Announcement No. 3-2026'.

candidate_sentences.text: In terms of capital position and cash flows, Impero strengthened its financial flexibility through a directed issue raising DKK 15M in December 2025, alongside warrant exercises.
Consequently, cash and cash equivalents increased to DKK 18,900 thousand as of 31 December 2025, compared to DKK 9,798 thousand at the end of 2024.

Following the improved capital position and solid SaaS metrics, the Board of Directors concluded that growth investments will create more long-term shareholder value than pursuing cash flow positivity before the end of 2026.

verified_key_information_units.information: The Board accelerated commercial investments for 2026 (including new hires) to increase ARR growth, expecting ARR of DKK 53-57M (+15-23% YoY) but EBITDA of DKK -2M to -1M due to higher costs.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Guidance for 2026: 'Impero expects ARR to reach between DKK 53M and 57M... ARR growth rate of approx. 15% to 23%... EBITDA expected to be in the range of DKK -2M to -1M... new planned hires across commercial organization will increase cost base'. Strategy update details investment plans.

candidate_sentences.text: Consequently, Impero deferred its ambition of achieving recurring positive cash flow by the end of 2026 and plans to accelerate commercial investments.

For the full year 2026, Impero expects ARR to reach between DKK 53M and 57M, reflecting a growth rate of approximately 15% to 23%, and anticipates EBITDA to be in the range of negative DKK 2M to positive DKK 1M.

verified_key_information_units.information: Expansion of partner network in DACH region to five revenue-generating partners complemented own channel, which generated 71% of new ARR in 2025.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management commentary: 'expanded our partner network in Germany... five revenue generating partners in the DACH region... working with several certified consultancies across the German speaking markets, including the four leading global auditing networks (Big4)... own channel led new ARR generation in 2025... new ARR from own channels constituted 71% of total new ARR... partners experienced delay in decision making from their customers, which dampened our partner sales in 2025'. Channel Split section confirms partner vs own channel contribution.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K6, and K7 are PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K3, K4, K5, and K8 are MISSING as there is no mention of customer base diversification, specific regional growth drivers, product milestones, or partner network expansion details in the candidate summary. The summary captures most high-importance financial and strategic guidance information but lacks several key operational and market-specific details, resulting in a 'Generally yes' assessment.

coherence_issues.description: Sentences S22 and S23 state that the Board deferred the ambition of achieving recurring positive cash flow by the end of 2026 and plans to accelerate commercial investments. However, the summary does not explicitly explain how or why accelerating commercial investments will create more long-term shareholder value than pursuing cash flow positivity before 2026, leaving a logical gap in the reasoning.

candidate_sentences.text: Following the improved capital position and solid SaaS metrics, the Board of Directors concluded that growth investments will create more long-term shareholder value than pursuing cash flow positivity before the end of 2026.
Consequently, Impero deferred its ambition of achieving recurring positive cash flow by the end of 2026 and plans to accelerate commercial investments.

details.coherence_justification: The summary is generally coherent with a clear structure covering revenue, profitability, SaaS metrics, cash flow, and future guidance. Most statements logically follow from one another, and there are no self-contradictions or major organizational issues. The primary issue is a logical gap in the explanation of the Board's decision to defer cash flow positivity and accelerate investments (S22, S23), as the connection between these actions and long-term shareholder value is asserted but not elaborated. There is no unnecessary repetition, and the arithmetic differences between segment and consolidated figures are not contradictions because the summary does not claim they are exhaustive additive components of the same total.
